mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status ) VALUES ( #{employeeNumber}, #{branchId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, #{passwordHash}, #{passwordHash}, #{employeeRole}, #{employeeStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE employee_number = #{employeeNumber}

SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})

SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} ORDER BY employee_id DESC

SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee ORDER BY employee_id DESC

SELECT employee_id, employee_number, branch_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, password_hash, password_changed, employee_role, employee_status, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE LOWER(employee_number) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(first_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(last_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(email) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY employee_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, employee_role = #{employeeRole}, employee_status = #{employeeStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
UPDATE employee SET employee_status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
UPDATE employee SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
